episodes.title: The Wounded Angel
episodes.summary: A disaster on board the International Space Station becomes a fight for survival.

episodes.title: Live and Let Live
episodes.summary: Jo races to find a way back to Earth before her life support runs out. Henry is concerned about his experiment.

episodes.title: Somewhere in Space Hangs My Heart
episodes.summary: The space agencies begin their investigation into the ISS collision. Jo struggles to reconnect with Magnus and Alice.

episodes.title: The Left Hand of God
episodes.summary: Jo's life back home is not how she remembers it, and growing tension with Magnus adds to her feelings of alienation.

episodes.title: Five Miles Out, the Sound Is Clearest
episodes.summary: While on the run with Alice, Jo makes a chilling discovery. Bud threatens to exact his revenge on Henry.

episodes.title: Paul Is Dead
episodes.summary: Magnus worries that Alice is living in a fantasy world.

episodes.title: Through the Looking Glass
episodes.summary: Lost and alone in the woods, Jo desperately tries to reunite with her daughter.

episodes.title: These Fragments I Have Shored Against My Ruin
episodes.summary: Season finale. Jo is taken to an astronaut rehabilitation clinic, where the truth is revealed.
